summary: Frontend-only test for the TAXA/PRAZO column fix on the Empréstimos page. Logged in as admin (diego.haidmann@gmail.com), Turnstile test mode passed, navigated to /emprestimos. Verified both cases: (1) sem_prazo (RODRIGO FERREIRA DA LUZ) now shows the badge '🔄 Aberto' plus the interest rate '15% / mês' rendered inside data-testid='taxa-juros-<id>' nested in 'taxa-prazo-<id>'; (2) com prazo fixo (HUDSON SANTIAGO RAMOS, Juros Simples) shows '33% / 1m' inside 'taxa-prazo-<id>' with NO 'taxa-juros-<id>' element. Additional visual confirmation across the loan list shows multiple sem_prazo loans correctly displaying rates like '15% / mês', '30% / mês', '33.5% / mês', '20% / mês', '35% / mês' below the Aberto badge. Data restored from backup loads correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Row for 'Valdinei Alves Dos Santos' (Juros Simples, com prazo) displays 'null% / nullm' because taxa_juros_mensal / prazo_meses are null in the persisted document. Pre-existing data/fallback issue, not related to this session's change, but should be handled defensively (e.g., fallback to '-' or hide).

action_items: Optional: add null-safe rendering in the com-prazo branch of the TAXA/PRAZO column so rows with missing taxa_juros_mensal/prazo_meses don't render literal 'null% / nullm' (affects Valdinei Alves Dos Santos row).
critical_code_review_comments: getTaxaSemPrazoLabel is well-guarded against null/undefined/'' — good.
The com-prazo branch (line ~752 desktop and ~850 mobile) uses string interpolation without null-guards, which is the source of the 'null% / nullm' rendering for legacy/incomplete records.

seed_data_creation: None; used existing restored data (RODRIGO, HUDSON).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature 'display taxa de juros next to Aberto badge for sem_prazo loans' is fully implemented and verified in both desktop and mobile branches of /app/frontend/src/pages/Emprestimos.js. data-testids in use: taxa-prazo-<id> (container) and taxa-juros-<id> (rate line, only present when sem_prazo=true and taxa is not null). One unrelated pre-existing bug: Valdinei row shows 'null% / nullm' (null-safe rendering missing in com-prazo branch).
